version.description:
Adjusting any nodes mutating "Inventory Transaction"

Adjust CustomData to handle cases where a user triggered a parent flow that called this flow using ExecuteFlow.

CustomData checks if CLAIMS was passed in at the request node, if not then it uses the claims passed from the users request.
